subject: Request: short extension and resource boost for Humanitarian Mapping Lab trial
messages:
From: Dr. Amina Rahman <amina.rahman@map4good.org>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.example, marissa_cole@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: short extension and resource boost for Humanitarian Mapping Lab trial

Hi Sean / Marissa,

Thanks again for the trial access — the team at Map4Good has been evaluating Redwood for real-time feature extraction for our field mapping workflows. We have a sharply time-boxed deployment: a partner NGO is deploying volunteer mappers next week and we need to process imagery annotations and routing guidance while in the field.

We are almost at the end of our hosted trial credits and the evaluation cutover is mid-week (9/14). Would Redwood be able to: 1) add an extra two weeks to our trial window (until 9/28), and 2) temporarily increase our token quota by ~75k tokens and short-term concurrency (2 extra concurrent requests) for the period 9/13–9/20? The extra capacity will let us run batch anonymization + live routing experiments during field ops.

We are a small non-profit; we have a grant letter attached that explains the field activity and funding constraints. If you need any formal paperwork from procurement or a short MOU, we can provide it.

Appreciate any help you can provide on short notice — our operations team will be on a tight timeline.

Best,
Amina
Dr. Amina Rahman
Director, Humanitarian Mapping Lab
Map4Good

Attachments: Map4Good-field-deployment-letter.pdf (PDF, 128 KB)

---
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.example
To: Dr. Amina Rahman <amina.rahman@map4good.org>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 7 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: short extension and resource boost for Humanitarian Mapping Lab trial

Hi Amina — thanks for the details and for the attachment.

Short answer: likely yes. I want to confirm a couple quick things so I can get the approvals routed today:
- Is the 75k tokens estimate total for the 9/13–9/20 window (not per day)?
- Do you need guaranteed throughput (reserved concurrency) or would a transient concurrency bump with an increased per-minute quota be sufficient?
- Any data residency / access restrictions we should be aware of for the field team (VPN, IP allowlist, or specific region)?

If the answers are straightforward I can propose a temporary promotional boost and handle the coordination with our grants/billing team. If you’re free, I can jump on a quick 15-min call this afternoon to sort the details.

Next steps from our side: I’ll flag this to Marissa (account lead) and Ben (grants/credits), and propose the promotional code & window once we have internal sign-off.

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Account Exec, Nonprofit & Research
Redwood Inference

---
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.example
To: marissa_cole@redwood.example, ben_carter@redwood.example, monica_patel@redwood.example
Date: Tue, 8 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Request: short extension and resource boost for Humanitarian Mapping Lab trial

Marissa / Ben / Monica — forwarding a request from Map4Good. Key asks: +2 weeks on trial (until 2026-09-28) and a one-week resource bump (75k tokens + 2 concurrency) for 9/13–9/20 to support field ops. They included a grant letter.

Why I’m recommending approval:
- Non-profit, public-interest project with tight field timeline.
- Small consumption footprint overall; we convert faster when we support live demos during deployments.
- Risk: minimal, standard trial terms; no custom SLA needed.

Suggested offer (conservative):
- Promo credit: 75,000 token credit applied 9/13–9/20.
- Trial extension: extend current trial expiration to 2026-09-28.
- Concurrency: short-term soft quota bump of +2 concurrency for 9/13–9/20 (no dedicated instances).

If legal wants a one-page MOU we can route that, but I think we can proceed with a promo code + extension and simple confirmation email. Ben — can you confirm whether we need to log this against the non-profit credit bucket or treat this as a one-off promotional grant? Monica — any billing/finance signoff needed for the promo code?

If you all OK this, I’ll send the confirmation to Amina and include the promo code and a short instructions doc.

Thanks,
Sean

---
From: marissa_cole@redwood.example
To: Dr. Amina Rahman <amina.rahman@map4good.org>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.example, ben_carter@redwood.example
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 16:29:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: short extension and resource boost for Humanitarian Mapping Lab trial

Hi Amina — happy to help.

We’ve approved a one-off promotional boost and trial extension to support your upcoming field deployment. Details below: 

- Promo credit: REDWOOD-MAP-75000 — 75,000 token credit applied automatically to your account on 2026-09-13 and valid until 2026-09-20.
- Trial extension: your trial window has been extended to 2026-09-28.
- Concurrency: we’ve applied a temporary concurrency soft-bump of +2 for 2026-09-13 through 2026-09-20. This is not a dedicated instance; it’s capacity-managed and subject to overall regional limits.

Action items for Map4Good:
- Confirm you see the promo code in your account and that the trial dates are updated by 9/12 EOD. If anything looks off, reply to this thread.
- If you need a signed MOU for internal grant reporting, reply and we’ll route a one-page confirmation via DocuSign.

Attached: Map4Good-Trial-Boost-20260910.pdf — short summary of the boost and parameters for your records.

We’re rooting for the deployment — feel free to ping Sean during the field window if you hit rate or latency issues and we’ll triage.

Warmly,
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Map4Good-Trial-Boost-20260910.pdf (PDF, 35 KB)
